NEW YORKERS PINBALL

A NEW YORKERS GAME BY MLOW

How to play

  • Flippers: Z and /, the shift keys, or the arrow keys. On a phone, tap the left or right half of the screen.
  • Launch: hold Space or the down arrow, let go. On a phone, hold anywhere on the right while the ball sits in the lane.
  • Nudge: X and C. Three in a row is a warning. Three warnings is a tilt.
  • Pause: P or Esc.

Hit the three STOPS under the El to light the TUNNEL. The doors in front of it open and shut on their own; three hits on the doors hold them open.

The EXPRESS ramp lights the lock. Ride THE EL three times while the lock is lit for multiball, a train full of balls.

The TUNNEL swallows the ball and the token booth gives it back. Finish every mode to light GET COUNTED.

Each mode puts one New Yorker from the census on the table. Finish it and they are counted, and they stay counted on this device. Count all eight in one game to light GET COUNTED.

Tonight's table is the same twist for everyone until midnight in New York.
